title: Dynamic Commitment Conversion & Marketplace Credit Application Playbook
creator: Sana Patel
description: Operational playbook for handling customer requests that ask to convert existing usage charges into commitments, apply marketplace credits or split commitments across invoices and teams. This ticket codifies intake, prioritization, validation checks, and downstream work required to fulfill these non-bug pricing/packaging requests while preserving accounting correctness and minimizing manual intervention.
triage_rubric: Urgency: Is the customer at risk of churn or legal/contractual breach? (High/Medium/Low)
Financial magnitude: Estimated revenue/credit value (> $100k high, $10k-$100k medium, < $10k low)
Operational complexity: Requires changes to billing system, invoicing, or inter-team coordination?
Timing constraints: End-of-quarter, renewal, or marketplace settlement windows
Compliance scope: Data residency, tax, or legal implications
workflow_steps: Intake: Use the billing-request form (linked) and label request type 'commitment-conversion' or 'marketplace-credit'.
Triage: PM reviews within 48 hours using triage rubric, flags if legal/finance review required.
Validation: Finance runs invoice reconciliation to confirm current charges, marketplace credits, and any tax effects.
Proposal: PM drafts conversion proposal with 3 options (full conversion, prorated credit, hybrid split) and estimated financial impact.
Customer approval: Obtain signed acceptance on conversion option and effective dates.
Execution: Finance/Revenue Ops applies credits, issues adjustment invoices or credits, and updates commitment records.
Verification: Confirm adjustments on customer portal, invoice feeds, and accounting systems; notify customer.
Post-mortem: Log lessons, update playbook, and flag product/automation opportunities if manual steps repeated.
decision_matrix: If customer value >= $100k and risk of churn: approve fast-track; schedule emergency revenue ops slot.
If marketplace credits originate from third-party vendor: require marketplace-team signoff and contract verification.
If conversion would create negative future invoicing (credit > forecasted usage): recommend staged conversion with cap.
If change alters tax/jurisdiction treatment: require finance + legal approval before execution.
acceptance_criteria: All accounting entries necessary to reflect the conversion are posted and reconcile with ledger.
Customer-facing invoices/portal show adjusted balances and breakdown of applied credits.
Internal tracking ticket closed with resolution notes, change request logged in commitments ledger.
Automation candidate identified if manual effort > 2 hours for similar future requests.
metrics: Time to resolution (target < 10 business days for medium complexity)
Number of manual Journal Entries created per request
Repeat requests for similar conversion patterns (automation signal)
risks_and_mitigations: Incorrect tax treatment: Mitigation - require finance sign-off and preserve audit trail
Marketplace credit misuse: Mitigation - verify vendor origin and usage terms with partnerships
Ledger mismatch: Mitigation - two-person verification and reconciliation checklist
Unintended SLA impact: Mitigation - coordinate with Sales to set realistic effective dates
